u01-grandma-up.note: Usable: she is clearly upstairs; small but readable at 360 px in the 4:5 crop; the staircase and hallway floor show the two levels.

u02-grandma-down.observed_description: The grandmother in her light-blue cardigan, holding the folded white towel, stands on the hallway floor at the foot of the same staircase; the upstairs landing is empty.
u02-grandma-down.note: Usable: downstairs reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; same staircase and camera as u01.

u03-boy-up.observed_description: A boy in a red T-shirt and jeans stands on the upstairs landing at the top of the same staircase; the stairs and hallway are empty.
u03-boy-up.note: Usable: upstairs reads at 360 px and in the 4:5 crop; small but clear.

u04-boy-down.observed_description: The boy in the red T-shirt stands on the hallway floor at the foot of the same staircase, smiling; the landing is empty.
